# DevUI for Angular - Quick Reference | 快速参考

PROJECT_NAME: DevUI (ng-devui)
FRAMEWORK: Angular
LANGUAGE: TypeScript
VERSION: 18.0.0
ANGULAR_VERSION: 21.1.0 (实际使用版本)
LAST_UPDATE: 2026-02-07
DOCUMENTATION_URL: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/get-start
ICON_LIBRARY: https://devui.design/icon/ruleResource
GITHUB: https://github.com/DevCloudFE/ng-devui
NPM_PACKAGE: ng-devui

---

## Component Catalog | 组件目录

### Basic Components | 基础组件

- **Button** (`ng-devui/button`)
  - Selector: `d-button`
  - Module: `ButtonModule`
  - Props: `bsStyle`, `bsSize`, `disabled`, `icon`, `showLoading`, `bordered`, `shape`
  - bsStyle: `common | primary | text | text-dark | danger | success | warning`
  - bsSize: `lg | md | sm | xs`
  - Output: `btnClick`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/button/demo

- **Card** (`ng-devui/card`)
  - Selector: `d-card`
  - Module: `CardModule`
  - Props: `interactive`
  - Sub-components: `d-card-header`, `d-card-title`, `d-card-subtitle`, `d-card-content`, `d-card-actions`
  - d-card-actions Props: `align` (start | end | center | spaceBetween)
  - ⚠️ Note: `d-card-avatar` may not work in standalone components, use native div instead
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/card/demo

- **Icon** (`ng-devui/icon`)
  - Selector: `d-icon`
  - Module: `IconModule`
  - Props: `icon`, `color`, `cssClass`
  - ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Use `icon` attribute (not `name`) for binding: `[icon]="iconName"`
  - ⚠️ For static usage: `<d-icon icon="icon-search"></d-icon>`
  - Common Icons (prefix with `icon-`):
    - Navigation: `arrow-left`, `arrow-right`, `arrow-up`, `arrow-down`, `chevron-left`, `chevron-right`
    - Actions: `add`, `delete`, `edit`, `search`, `close`, `check`, `refresh`, `download`, `upload`
    - Status: `success`, `error`, `warning`, `info`, `help`, `star`, `star-o`
    - Files: `folder`, `file`, `document`, `image`, `video`, `audio`
    - System: `setting`, `user`, `home`, `menu`, `more-oper`, `filter`, `sort`
    - Dev: `code`, `git`, `git-merge`, `pipeline`, `archive`, `test`, `book`
    - Cloud: `cloud`, `server`, `database`, `api`, `network`
    - Media: `play`, `pause`, `stop`, `run`, `terminal`
  - Icon Reference: https://devui.design/icon/ruleResource
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/icon/demo

- **Badge** (`ng-devui/badge`)
  - Selector: `d-badge`
  - Module: `BadgeModule`
  - Props: `count`, `status`, `showDot`, `position`
  - status: `danger | warning | waiting | success | info`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/badge/demo

- **Status** (`ng-devui/status`)
  - Selector: `d-status`
  - Module: `StatusModule`
  - Props: `type`
  - type: `success | error | warning | initial | waiting | running | invalid`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/status/demo

- **Tag** (`ng-devui/tags`)
  - Selector: `d-tag`
  - Module: `TagsModule`
  - Props: `tag`, `labelStyle`, `deletable`, `customColor`
  - labelStyle: `default | primary | success | warning | danger`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/tags/demo

- **Avatar** (`ng-devui/avatar`)
  - Selector: `d-avatar`
  - Module: `AvatarModule`
  - Props: `name`, `width`, `height`, `customText`, `imgSrc`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/avatar/demo

### Form Components | 表单组件

- **TextInput** (`ng-devui/text-input`)
  - Selector: `d-text-input`
  - Module: `TextInputModule`
  - Props: `placeholder`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `size`, `maxLength`, `cssClass`, `autofocus`
  - size: `lg | md | sm`
  - Outputs: `valueChange`, `focus`, `blur`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/text-input/demo

- **Search** (`ng-devui/search`)
  - Selector: `d-search`
  - Module: `SearchModule`
  - Props: `placeholder`, `size`, `isKeyupSearch`, `delay`
  - Outputs: `searchFn`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/search/demo

- **Textarea** (`ng-devui/textarea`)
  - Selector: `d-textarea`
  - Module: `TextareaModule`
  - Props: `placeholder`, `disabled`, `maxLength`, `resize`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/textarea/demo

- **Select** (`ng-devui/select`)
  - Selector: `d-select`
  - Module: `SelectModule`
  - Props: `options`, `isSearch`, `multiple`, `disabled`, `placeholder`, `filterKey`, `valueKey`, `labelKey`, `size`
  - size: `lg | md | sm`
  - Outputs: `toggleChange`, `valueChange`, `loadMore`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/select/demo

- **Checkbox** (`ng-devui/checkbox`)
  - Selector: `d-checkbox`
  - Module: `CheckBoxModule`
  - Props: `label`, `disabled`, `isShowTitle`, `halfChecked`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/checkbox/demo

- **Radio** (`ng-devui/radio`)
  - Selector: `d-radio`
  - Module: `RadioModule`
  - Props: `value`, `name`, `disabled`, `cssClass`
  - ⚠️ Use with `[(ngModel)]` and `[value]` for proper binding
  - Output: `change`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/radio/demo

- **Switch/Toggle** (`ng-devui/toggle`)
  - Selector: `d-toggle`
  - Module: `ToggleModule`
  - Props: `disabled`, `size`, `color`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/toggle/demo

- **InputNumber** (`ng-devui/input-number`)
  - Selector: `d-input-number`
  - Module: `InputNumberModule`
  - Props: `min`, `max`, `step`, `size`, `disabled`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/input-number/demo

- **Slider** (`ng-devui/slider`)
  - Selector: `d-slider`
  - Module: `SliderModule`
  - Props: `min`, `max`, `step`, `disabled`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/slider/demo

- **DatePicker** (`ng-devui/datepicker`)
  - Selector: `d-datepicker`
  - Module: `DatepickerModule`
  - Props: `cssClass`, `dateFormat`, `showTime`, `disabled`, `minDate`, `maxDate`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/datepicker/demo

- **TimePicker** (`ng-devui/time-picker`)
  - Selector: `d-time-picker`
  - Module: `TimePickerModule`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/time-picker/demo

- **Upload** (`ng-devui/upload`)
  - Selector: `d-upload`
  - Module: `UploadModule`
  - Props: `uploadOptions`, `multiple`, `accept`, `disabled`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/upload/demo

- **Form** (`ng-devui/form`)
  - ⚠️ IMPORTANT: `d-form` container may not work in Angular 21 standalone components
  - ✅ Use native `<form>` with DevUI sub-components instead
  - Sub-components: `d-form-item`, `d-form-label`, `d-form-control`
  - d-form-item Props: `labelSize`, `labelWidth`, `labelAlign`
  - Module: `FormModule`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/form/demo

### Data Display | 数据展示

- **Table** (`ng-devui/data-table`)
  - Selector: `d-data-table`
  - Module: `DataTableModule`
  - Props: `dataSource`, `columns`, `checkable`, `pageable`, `scrollable`, `lazy`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/table/demo

- **Tree** (`ng-devui/tree`)
  - Selector: `d-tree`
  - Module: `TreeModule`
  - Props: `data`, `checkable`, `expandAll`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/tree/demo

- **Pagination** (`ng-devui/pagination`)
  - Selector: `d-pagination`
  - Module: `PaginationModule`
  - Props: `total`, `pageSize`, `pageIndex`, `pageSizeOptions`, `showTotal`, `showJumpPage`, `showPageSelector`
  - Outputs: `pageIndexChange`, `pageSizeChange`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/pagination/demo

- **Progress** (`ng-devui/progress`)
  - Selector: `d-progress`
  - Module: `ProgressModule`
  - Props: `percentage`, `percentageText`, `strokeColor`, `type`
  - type: `line | circle`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/progress/demo

- **Loading** (`ng-devui/loading`)
  - Selector: `d-loading` (directive)
  - Module: `LoadingModule`
  - Service: `LoadingService`
  - Props: `loading`, `message`, `backdrop`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/loading/demo

- **Empty** (`ng-devui/common`)
  - Selector: `d-empty`
  - Module: `DCommonModule`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/empty/demo

- **Drawer** (`ng-devui/drawer`)

  - Props: `visible`, `position`, `width`, `showAnimation`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/drawer/demo

- **Toast** (`ng-devui/toast`)
  - Selector: `d-toast`
  - Module: `ToastModule`
  - Service: `ToastService`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/toast/demo

- **Alert** (`ng-devui/alert`)
  - Selector: `d-alert`
  - Module: `AlertModule`
  - Props: `type`, `showIcon`, `closable`
  - type: `success | danger | warning | info | simple`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/alert/demo

- **Tooltip** (`ng-devui/tooltip`)
  - Directive: `dTooltip`
  - Module: `TooltipModule`
  - Props: `content`, `position`, `showAnimation`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/tooltip/demo

- **Popover** (`ng-devui/popover`)
  - Selector: `d-popover`
  - Module: `PopoverModule`
  - Props: `visible`, `position`, `trigger`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/popover/demo

### Navigation | 导航

- **Menu** (`ng-devui/menu`)

- **Accordion** (`ng-devui/accordion`)
  - Selector: `d-accordion`

- **Anchor** (`ng-devui/anchor`)

- **BackTop** (`ng-devui/back-top`)

  - Module: `BackTopModule`

### Layout | 布局

- **Layout** (`ng-devui/layout`)
  - Selectors: `d-layout`, `d-header`, `d-aside`, `d-content`, `d-footer`
  - Module: `LayoutModule`
  - Props (d-aside): `width`, `collapsible`, `collapsed`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/layout/demo

- **Row/Col Grid** (`ng-devui/layout`)
  - Selectors: `d-row`, `d-col`
  - Module: `LayoutModule`
  - d-row Props: `dGutter`, `dAlign`, `dJustify`
  - d-col Props: `dSpan` (1-24), `dOffset`, `dPush`, `dPull`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/layout/demo

- **Splitter** (`ng-devui/splitter`)
  - Selector: `d-splitter`
  - Module: `SplitterModule`
  - Docs: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/splitter/demo

## Quick Start | 快速开始

### Installation | 安装

```bash
npm install ng-devui @angular/animations
```

### Import Module | 导入模块

```typescript
// Standalone Component
import { ButtonModule } from 'ng-devui/button';

@Component({
  imports: [ButtonModule],
  // ...
})

// Or use DevUIModule (NgModule)
import { DevUIModule } from 'ng-devui';

@NgModule({
  imports: [DevUIModule],
  // ...
})
```

### Import Styles | 导入样式

In `angular.json`:
```json
{
  "styles": [
    "src/styles.css",
    "node_modules/ng-devui/devui.min.css"
  ]
}
```

### Configure Animations | 配置动画

In `app.config.ts`:
```typescript
import { provideAnimations } from '@angular/platform-browser/animations';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideAnimations()  // Required for DevUI components
  ]
};
```

### Basic Usage | 基本用法

```html
<d-button bsStyle="primary" bsSize="md">主要按钮</d-button>

<d-card>
  <d-card-header>
    <d-card-title>卡片标题</d-card-title>
  </d-card-header>
  <d-card-content>卡片内容</d-card-content>
  <d-card-actions align="end">
    <d-button bsStyle="primary">操作</d-button>
  </d-card-actions>
</d-card>

<!-- Form (Hybrid approach for standalone components) -->
<form class="devui-form">
  <d-form-item>
    <d-form-label>标签</d-form-label>
    <d-form-control>
      <d-text-input placeholder="请输入内容"></d-text-input>
    </d-form-control>
  </d-form-item>
</form>

<!-- Icon Usage -->
<d-icon icon="icon-search"></d-icon>
<d-icon [icon]="dynamicIconName" color="#5E7CE0"></d-icon>
```

## Design Tokens | 设计令牌

### Project Configuration | 项目配置

**Method**: Static CSS Variables in `src/styles.css`  
**Why**: Simple setup for experimental project (see `app.config.ts` comments for ThemeService alternative)

### AI Quick Reference | AI 快速参考

When generating UI code, use these most common values:

| Category | Value | CSS Variable |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| **Primary Color** | `#5E7CE0` | `var(--devui-primary)` |
| **Text** | `#252B3A` | `var(--devui-text-primary)` |
| **Background** | `#FFFFFF` / `#F2F3F5` | `var(--devui-bg-container)` / `var(--devui-bg-page)` |
| **Spacing** | `16px` (md) | `var(--devui-spacing-md)` |
| **Font Size** | `12px` (body) | `var(--devui-font-size-body)` |

**Usage Pattern**:
```css
.element {
  color: var(--devui-text-primary);      /* ✅ Preferred */
  padding: var(--devui-spacing-lg);       /* ✅ Use tokens */
  background: #FFFFFF;                    /* ⚠️ OK for V1/V2, avoid in V3 Hybrid */
}
```

### Common Mistakes | 常见错误

AI must avoid these incorrect values found in some old references:

| ❌ Wrong | ✅ Correct | Note |
|----------|-----------|------|
| `#165DFF` | `#5E7CE0` | Primary color |
| `#F53F3F` | `#F66F6A` | Danger color |
| `#00B42A` | `#3AC295` | Success color |
| `14px` | `12px` | Body font size |
| `#E5E6EB` | `#ADB0B8` | Border color |

### Full Reference | 完整参考

- **Token Catalog**: https://devui.design/design-tokens/zh-cn/overview
- **Theme System**: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/theme/demo
- **Project Tokens**: See `src/styles.css` for complete list

## Key Constraints | 关键约束

⚠️ **IMPORTANT**: Always use official DevUI components. Do NOT create custom implementations using native HTML elements.

⚠️ **重要提示**: 始终使用官方 DevUI 组件。禁止使用原生 HTML 元素创建自定义实现。

### Version Compatibility | 版本兼容性

- **Angular**: 21.1.0 (实际使用)
- **DevUI**: 18.0.0 (声明支持 Angular ^18.0.0)
- **Status**: ⚠️ 版本不匹配但可以运行

### Known Issues | 已知问题

- ⚠️ `d-form` container may not work in Angular 21 standalone components
  - ✅ Use native `<form>` with DevUI sub-components (`d-form-item`, `d-form-label`, `d-form-control`) instead
- ⚠️ `d-icon` uses `icon` attribute (not `name`) for dynamic binding
  - ✅ Use `[icon]="iconName"` or static `icon="icon-search"`
- ⚠️ `d-card-avatar` may not work in standalone components
  - ✅ Use native div with custom styles instead

### Forbidden Practices | 禁止做法

- ❌ Inline styles (`[style]`, `[ngStyle]`) for component styling
- ❌ Hardcoded colors (#xxx, rgb, rgba) - use tokens
- ❌ Hardcoded dimensions without variables - use tokens
- ❌ Custom CSS overriding component styles
- ❌ Using native HTML elements instead of DevUI components
- ❌ Using deprecated APIs (e.g., `bsPosition` in Button)
- ❌ Using wrong color values
---

For complete constraints and API specifications, see `llms-full.txt`.

完整的约束和 API 规范，请参阅 `llms-full.txt`。
